The '''2020 Munster Senior Hurling Championship Final''' was a [[hurling]] match that was played on 1 November at [[Semple Stadium]] in [[Thurles]]. It was contested by defending champions [[Limerick county hurling team|Limerick]] and [[Waterford county hurling team|Waterford]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.limerickleader.ie/news/sport/587377/countdown-begins-to-limerick-and-waterford-munster-hurling-final-clash.html|title = Countdown begins to Limerick and Waterford Munster hurling final clash|date= 9 November 2020|work=Limerick Leader|accessdate=11 November 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/2020/1115/1178294-limerick-v-waterford-munster-shc-final-updates/|title= Munster SHC final recap: Limerick 0-25 v Waterford 0-21|date=1 November 2020|work=[[RTÉ Sport]] |accessdate=2 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.the42.ie/limerick-waterford-munster-shc-live-score-updates-5267797-Nov2020/|title= 2020 Munster SHC final: As it happened|date=1 November 2020|work=The 42|accessdate=2 December 2020}}</ref>

Limerick, captained by [[Declan Hannon]], retained the title after a 0-25 to 0-21 win.<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/gaelic-games/hurling/limerick-eventually-shake-off-waterford-to-claim-munster-title-1.4410045|title= Limerick eventually shake off Waterford to claim Munster title|date=1 November 2020|work=Irish Times|accessdate=2 December 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url= https://munster.gaa.ie/event/2020-munster-gaa-senior-hurling-championship-final/|title=  Limerick 0-25 Waterford 0-21|date=1 November 2020|work=Munster GAA|accessdate=2 December 2020}}</ref>

The same two teams went on to contest the [[2020 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final|2020 All-Ireland SHC final]] on 13 December, with Limerick again winning by 0-30 to 0-19.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.irishtimes.com/sport/gaelic-games/hurling/live-all-ireland-hurling-final-limerick-0-30-waterford-0-19-ft-1.4435608|title=LIVE All-Ireland hurling final: Limerick 0-30 Waterford 0-19 (FT)|date=13 December 2020|work=Irish Times|accessdate= 11 May 2021}}</ref>
